output.objection: You are missing the point because a shadow environment without a formal sign-off gate is just a leak waiting to happen. I need a strict, auditable review step before any model moves from shadow to production, and that is non-negotiable for our data governance posture.
output.correction: I am not talking about the model accuracy metrics or the forecast quality, which are handled by the data science team. I am defining the security and compliance controls that must wrap the entire promotion workflow, so please stop conflating performance with governance.
